about.title: About Bayshore Chiropractic and Wellness
text: Elyssa Molina-Arevalo, DC is passionate about helping patients move better, feel stronger, and live healthier lives through modern, evidence-based chiropractic care. A native of La Porte, Texas, Dr. Molina is proud to now serve the community she calls home.

She began her academic journey at Abilene Christian University, where she completed her undergraduate studies in Biology before earning her Doctor of Chiropractic degree from Texas Chiropractic College. During her education and clinical training, Dr. Molina developed a strong focus on patient-centered, evidence-based care.

Since graduating, Dr. Molina has worked as an associate chiropractor throughout the Greater Houston area while also providing mobile chiropractic services, giving her the opportunity to care for patients in both clinical and on-the-go settings. Through this experience, she has treated a wide variety of patients and enjoys caring for everyone from babies to powerlifters to grandparents, believing each patient deserves an individualized approach to care. She is also Webster Certified, allowing her to provide specialized chiropractic care for pregnant mothers and support healthy pregnancies.
